contract.terms_text: Room rates quoted are per room, per night, inclusive of all taxes and are non-commissionable. Any new taxes introduced by the Government of Sri Lanka that result in additional costs shall be borne by the travel agent. The hotel reserves the right to modify the rates at any time; such changes will apply to all future bookings. All reservations should be sent to the provided reservation email addresses, unless otherwise specified. The agency cannot assign or grant any rights in this contract to third parties without written consent from the hotel. The rates in the agreement are strictly confidential and must not be disclosed to third parties. The use or publication of these rates in electronics distribution system (websites, OTAs, GDS, etc) is prohibited without prior agreement of the hotel. Full payment must be settled 7 days prior to the date of arrival. If a booking is made within 7 days of the date of arrival, payment must be made in full upon booking confirmation. Bookings will be released without prior notice if payment is not made before the deadline. In instances where the hotel is overbooked, the hotel reserves the right to transfer reservations to alternate accommodation facilities of similar rating. Booking procedure: the rooming list should be forwarded to the hotel 30 days prior to arrival (if not, it will be subject to cancellation); all booking requests are subject to written confirmation from the reservations department; the room rate must be indicated on the reservation voucher and if any special rates given to be mentioned. Check in 1400 hours / check out 1200 hours. Overbooking: in the event the hotel is oversold, hotel will provide accommodation at a comparable hotel. The exchange rates given by the Tourist Hotels Association of Sri Lanka to be applied on the date of departure.
contract.voucher_note: The room rate must be indicated on the reservation voucher and if any special rates given to be mentioned.
contract.notes: The booklet prices the same room category in a separate table per source market; each market table is a plan of its own (one plan cannot hold two rates for the same room type on the same night). Cover page: "STRICTLY CONFIDENTIAL – Sri Lankan DMC Contract Rates, Club Palm Bay, Thalwila Wella, Thoduwawa, Marawila, Sri Lanka, 01st May to 31st October 2026". Summer 2026 only — the booklet carries no winter table, so nothing is priced for 01 Nov 2026 onwards (W01 gap does not arise, the validity stops on 31 Oct 2026). "August Supplement: No", "Credit Facilities: No". The rate tables carry NO room-category heading (Sigiriya's say "SUPERIOR", The Palms' say "DELUXE"); the priced category is entered as "Standard Room" — please have the hotel confirm the name. The only other category printed is the Garden Suite (+USD 80 per room per night). The "Child Supplement Sharing Bed" column is entered as child_no_bed on every rate row (per child per night, 6 – 11 years, sharing the bed). Extra Meal Rates Breakfast USD 15.00 | Lunch USD 20.00 | Dinner USD 25 per person are entered as meal_prices only — the booklet prices BB, HB, FB and AI itself, so no meal_deltas are needed. Bank: Marawila Resorts PLC, A/C 1020011834, Commercial Bank, City Office Branch. This plan is the "EUROPEAN" table. VAT Registration No 114086223-7000.
